verdict.rationale: GitHub Actions is documented as a way to automate and execute software development workflows in the repository. Copilot cloud agent takes assigned tasks (issue → agent → pull request), researches, plans and makes changes on a branch in cloud sandboxes, with a central page to monitor agent sessions. Together these cover the core of background autonomous automation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of event/schedule triggers for unattended runs, explicit statement that agent tasks run asynchronously without supervision, independent or hands-on corroboration.
